sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, on 20.01.2017 the informant along with his elder daughter went for the treatment of his wife.
The informant had left his younger daughter (victim) at home.
On 22.01.2017, when he reached home, he got to know that his neighbour Amin Rishideo and his whole family had taken his daughter (victim) who was seriously injured for treatment.

In the hospital, the victim stated that on 21.01.2017 at 04:00 pm, Prabhash Chaudhary (this appellant) came at her house, finding her alone in the house, he caught hold of her, gagged her mouth and threw her on the ground and thereafter he committed rape on her due to which bleeding started from her private parts.
When she started bleeding, this appellant fled away.
Thereafter, she went at the house of neighbour Amin Rishideo and informed him about the occurrence.

Amin Rishideo along with his family brought her to local doctor for treatment where seeing the severity of the injuries, the doctor advised them to take her somewhere else for treatment thereafter neighbours took her for treatment.
Patna High Court CR.
While praying for suspension of sentence of appellant, learned counsel for the appellant submits that in this case, the defence has proved that there is an old land dispute.
It has also been contended that the doctor who had first treated the victim girl has not been found by the I.O. and he has not been examined.

6. On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that a prima-facie perusal of the records would show that this appellant is the sole perpetrator of the sexual violence against a ten years old child.
The evidence of the child is getting fully corroborated by the medical report, evidence of the doctor and the FSL report.

7. Having heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State as also on a prima-facie perusal of the records, we find that the victim in this case is a little girl aged about ten years and she has not only fully supported her case, the evidence in the form of medical report which has been proved by doctor (PW-4) and the FSL report fully corroborate the ocular evidence.
Blood mixed semen has been detected on the clothes of the victim and the doctor has reported that the victim was presented to her in painful condition and there were blood stain discharge.
Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.569 of 2021(7) dt.12-11-2024 8.
In these circumstances, this is not a fit case for grant of suspension of sentence and release on bail during pendency of the case.
The prayer is refused.
9. The observation made hereinabove are only tentative and prima-facie for purpose of consideration of the prayer for bail which will not cause any prejudice to either side.

10. List the appeal for hearing on its turn.
(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) ( Jitendra Kumar, J) SUSHMA2/-
